justification: Critical: production law-text changes on 3 SEPPs (455 rows retired or replaced with history; 423 applied, 32 prepared) and a migration that clears their review flags.

pre_impl.existing_data: DQ-88 read 3 after migration 096: Biodiversity, Planning Systems and Transport SEPPs, loaded from 2025 PDFs and never monitored until 2026-10-05; 459 stored rows held text the law has since changed.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: The first sweep matched sentences exactly against the 2025 copy and missed 34 rows whose formatting differed; a re-sweep on 8-word runs found them.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: Uses the version-history writer from scripts/dq88_refresh_2026_10_10.py (provision_versions v1/v2 plus provision_change_log), the 2026-09-15 method; never deletes.
pre_impl.external_source_error: Every replacement is cut verbatim from the in-force text on legislation.nsw.gov.au (fetched from the Fly monitor IP); retirements only where the wording is gone from the whole current instrument or two readers agree.
pre_impl.frontend_type: No frontend change; the site reads the same provision_text and is_current columns as before.
pre_impl.user_failure_mode: Without this, 174 rules shown on the site quote wording the law no longer contains, including repealed concurrence and notice duties.

falsifiable_check.fails_when: A plan row's stored text no longer matches what the plan was built from (the script refuses), or 099 runs before plan6 is applied (it refuses), or any instrument is still flagged after 099.
falsifiable_check.observed_red: Observed 2026-10-10: the first bulk dry run refused on row 22193 (plan built without the retire rows' text); the answer check refused 95 of 165 reader answers (wide ranges, generic wording), which went to exact-span readers and a second reader; 099's dry run refuses until plan6 is applied.

functions.name: run
functions.input: a database connection, the apply flag, and a reviewed plan file of retire or replace actions per row
functions.output: each row retired or replaced with version history, then committed or rolled back as a whole
functions.if_none: A row whose stored text differs from the plan's copy stops the run before anything commits.

values.value: In-force text of 3 SEPPs for the replaced rows
values.source: legislation.nsw.gov.au in-force HTML, verbatim, per instrument
values.if_missing: Retired rows are no longer served; no text is invented.

queries.purpose: plan row still matches stored text
queries.where_clause: id = %s (then is_current and text equality checked)
is_active AND needs_review AND version_date::date <= DATE '2026-10-10' AND instrument_key IN (3 keys)

break_it.scenario: A row changed after the plan was built
break_it.what_happens: The script refuses, names the row, and nothing in the run is committed

break_it.scenario: A reader places a passage in the wrong clause
break_it.what_happens: Refused unless the new text is word-similar and size-matched, or a second independent reader agrees on an overlapping span

break_it.scenario: A retirement would remove text that is still in force today
break_it.what_happens: Refused where more than 20% of the row's 8-word runs remain anywhere in the current law, unless two readers agree
break_it.how: shingle check against the whole current instrument

break_it.scenario: The review flags are cleared before the stored text is refreshed
break_it.what_happens: 099 refuses and clears nothing until the plan6 rows are retired

break_it.scenario: A new amendment to one of these SEPPs arrives before 099 runs
break_it.what_happens: 099 refuses: it clears only flags on the reviewed version and requires none left

post_merge.manual_verify: Done 2026-10-10: plan6 and migration 099 applied; python scripts/dq_probe_live.py --id DQ-88 reads 0 and python scripts/dq_check.py --outreach reads 17 of 17.

real_layer_exempt.scripts/dq88_sepp_bulk_refresh.py: Data refresh run against production 2026-10-10: plans 1-6 applied (455 rows).
real_layer_exempt.migrations/099_dq88_clear_three_refreshe: Applied to production 2026-10-10 after plan6; DQ-88 0.
